question:
Calculate personal income (in Rs. crore) from the given data. 

 
 

 **Particulars **
 Rs. (in crore)&l
solution:
The correct answer is __**1050**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Calculating Personal Income
 
 
• Private Income:
 
 
• This is the total income earned by individuals and businesses within a country, excluding government income.
 
 
 
• Net Retained Earnings:
 
 
• These are the profits that a company keeps after paying dividends to shareholders.
 
 
 
• Corporation Tax:
 
 
• This is a tax levied on the profits of corporations.
 
 
 
 
 
• Formula Used :
 
 
• Personal Income = Private Income - Net Retained Earnings - Corporation Tax
 
 
 
• **Given Data:**
 
 
• Private Income = Rs. 1800 crore
 
• Net Retained Earnings = Rs. 500 crore
 
• Corporation Tax = Rs. 250 crore
 
 
 
• Personal Income = 1800 crore - 500 crore - 250 crore = 1050 crore
 
• **Therefore, the personal income is Rs. 1050 crore.**
